title: A video clip's right-click menu leads with the picture, not the sound
goal: Right-clicking a video clip should offer what you do to a video first. Today a recording with sound gets a stack of audio rows (Detach Audio, Normalize, Clean Noise, Reset Gain, captions) mixed into its menu, which reads as if you right-clicked an audio clip.
notes:
User's words: "when i right click on a video clip, it gives me audio options. I only expect that on audio clips."

From code reading (not run): timelineClipMenuRows, Sources/Photonz/EditorState+TimelineMenus.swift:68. Audio rows key on layer.sound != nil, and Layer.sound returns the movie's own sound until detached (PhotonzCore/SoundClip.swift:76-80), so any recording with sound gets: Detach Audio (:151, canDetachSound SoundClip.swift:113-116), soundGainMenuRows (:159/:206: Normalize submenu, Clean Noise/Remove Noise Cleaning, Reset Gain), Add/Rewrite/Cancel Captions (:164, :397). The panel shows Sound, Fades, Gain, Sound Effects for a video clip too (InspectorPanel.swift:750-755, soundLayerInHand).

Related: the-panel-shows-what-the-picked-thing-is-and-its (blocked on the card 'How many buttons may the right hand panel keep?') moves panel one-shot buttons to right-click menus; coordinate so the video menu does not grow those back inline. Related fade task filed the same day: a video clip fades in and out (the 'Fades' label confusion is shared).
Trap: Detach Audio must stay easy to find on a video, it is how a person gets to its sound.
acceptance: Reproduce first: right-click a recording with sound and a recording without, and photograph both menus before changing anything

A video clip's right-click menu shows video rows (cut, transitions, fade, zoom, speed and so on) first; sound rows for a video that carries sound are grouped under one clearly named submenu (for example Audio) or reached through Detach Audio, not listed inline. The chosen layout is checked against docs/design IA placement rules and written in the audit
An audio clip (a detached or imported sound) keeps its sound rows at the top level, as today

Selecting a video clip does not put sound sections in the panel ahead of the clip's own picture sections; if Sound/Fades/Gain stay, they are clearly labelled as the clip's sound so 'Fades' is never mistaken for a picture fade
Every row that moved is still on the menu bar with its key
A walk at Next defaults photographs both menus and the panel for a video clip and an audio clip
Audit under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.

log.note: Reproduced (walk a-video-clip-menu-leads-with-the-picture-walk, probe, screen unlocked, real captures): right-click on the sample recording's V1 bar gives 22 rows with Detach Audio, Normalize, Clean Noise, Add Captions inline among Freeze/Punch In/Zoom; the linked sound segment under it gives the IDENTICAL menu; a detached sound gives its sound rows top level. Panel: TimePanelOrder.playing leads keys,speed,sound,fades,gain,soundEffects, so a picked recording shows Channel/Fades/Gain/Audio Effects above Appearance and Effects.

Design review before building: video.html draws an 'Audio' section only for an audio clip (kind aud), none for a video clip, so the user and the mock agree. Plan: (1) video bar menu = picture rows, then Detach Audio top level (Final Cut keeps Detach Audio top level on a video clip; it is how you reach the sound, the task's trap) and one 'Audio' submenu holding Normalize, Clean Noise/Reset Gain and Add Captions. (2) The linked sound segment on the Audio track is what a person sees as the audio clip: its menu leads with sound rows top level and drops picture-only rows (Freeze, Punch In, Add Click, zooms, Add Transition, Add Key). (3) Detached/imported sound unchanged. (4) Panel: a video's sound sections trail its picture sections (Appearance, Effects) and read Audio, Audio Fades, Audio Gain, Audio Effects, so 'Fades' is never read as a picture fade. Menu bar already carries Detach Audio, Normalize, Clean Noise, Reset Gain, Add Captions (EditorCommands.swift), untouched. Cost: on a laptop window a recording's Volume is no longer in view without scrolling; that is the user's ask (picture first) and video-panel-order-walk's expectation changes with it.

Rough items: Detach Audio dropping the sound's level settings FILED as detach-audio-keeps-the-sound-s-volume-fades-gain (reproduced in this task's walk). Left rough, not filed: Time section's Sound row on a video (it reports what a speed does to the sound, belongs with Speed); a video's audio below the fold at laptop size (the cost of picture first, the user's ask); Add Captions absent from a silent video's menu (still in the panel and the Captions menu); expectSections reports raw section titles (Color, Channel) where the panel draws Appearance and Audio, a harness-only naming wrinkle. Commit 9edbf52a.

Video bar menu leads with picture rows, then Detach Audio and one Audio submenu (Normalize, Clean Noise/Reset Gain, Add Captions); the linked sound segment and audio clips keep sound rows top level (ClipMenuPlan, EditorState+TimelineMenus). Panel: a recording's sound sections trail Appearance/Effects and read Audio, Audio Fades, Audio Gain, Audio Effects (TimePanelOrder). Menu bar untouched.
